title: logast.yaml
description: How a service should log, trace and measure. Anything left out uses the built-in default (`logast explain policy .` shows the final settings). Every option: docs/configuration.md.

extends.description: Policy layers this one builds on, applied first: a path, an https URL with #sha256=…, or fleet:<name>[@policy-N]

fleet.description: The fleet this service belongs to: its company.yaml is extended

rollout.description: This repo's say in a fleet rollout (#236): read from the default branch

mode.description: pr: rolled out as a pull request; manual: only when named with --repos; off: never (say why in hold)

hold.description: Hold the rollout, with the reason; "until YYYY-MM-DD" ends it on that day

packs.description: Which checks run; replaces the list of earlier layers
